test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Going through a sticky patch

options.text: To experience a bad period in life
To walk on a muddy road

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Going through a sticky patch"** means to experience a difficult or troublesome period in life. (कठिन समय से गुजरना) • **Example: **After losing his job, John has been **going through a sticky patch.** • **"To experience a bad period in life"** refers to facing challenges or hardships that make life tough. (जीवन में बुरे समय का अनुभव करना) • **Example: **She went through **a bad period in life **when her business failed. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To feel sad **(दुखी महसूस करना): To experience feelings of unhappiness or sorrow. • **Example:** She started to feel sad after hearing the bad news. • **To walk on a muddy road **(कीचड़ भरी सड़क पर चलना): To physically walk on a road that is covered in mud. • **Example: **We had to walk on a muddy road to reach the village. • **Try to paste something unsuccessfully** (कुछ चिपकाने की असफल कोशिश करना): To attempt to stick something but fail. • **Example:** He tried to paste the poster on the wall but it kept falling down. 45:Tc9e, The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
